messages:
Asha (People Ops): Quick manager-onboarding checklist for Tom who starts Monday. Keeping this tight so IT/HR can action.

Pre-day (today):
- Confirm preferred display name and emergency contact (Mira).
- Manager access: dashboards + org chart edit rights (Sam).
- Device & badge: Jordan confirm pickup or courier.
- Set up recurring 1:1s with direct reports and skip-level blocks.
- Invite to manager sync, hiring review, and leadership channel.

Day 1 highlights:
- 09:30: HR intro & benefits (Mira).
- 11:00: Product + metrics overview (PM lead).
- 14:00: Team rituals + meet direct reports (no slides).
- 16:00: 30/60/90 calibration w/ People Ops (Asha) — quick template provided.

Week 1 goals:
- Confirm direct reports' 30d goals and open feedback channels.
- Review oncall rota and access to incident runbooks.
- Complete manager training module (leadership basics).

Template snippets (copy into 1:1):
- 30d: Meet people, understand top blockers, define 3 immediate priorities.
- 60d: Start running team planning, small process improvements, 1:1 cadence set.
- 90d: Deliver on a team-level metric and propose hiring needs.

Logistics:
- HR portal: https://hr.redwood.local/manager-onboard (Mira)
- Dashboard access form: /forms/manager-dashboard (Sam)
- Badge pickup: Security desk or courier (Jordan)

Tom (New Manager): Thanks Asha — can you add the hiring pipeline doc to my checklist? I have interviews Wednesday.

Asha (People Ops): Added hiring pipeline & interview scorecard to OnboardBot checklist. Also set reminder for interview calibration prep.

Jordan (IT): Laptop queued (14\" MBP) and badge printed. Pickup at 09:00 or I'll courier. Need personal phone for MFA or we can issue a YubiKey.

Mira (HR): Sending calendar invites for HR intro + manager training. Please complete background docs within 48 hours to avoid payroll delay.

Sam (DevOps): Granting Grafana and incident-runbook read/edit permissions once Sam gets manager's GitHub handle. Tom, DM me the handle.

OnboardBot: Created manager checklist ID OB-1729991234. Tasks: device, dashboard request, interview docs, manager-training. Link: https://onboard.redwood.local/checklist/OB-1729991234

Tom (New Manager): Will DM GitHub handle and upload documents tonight. Appreciate the clear list.

Asha (People Ops): Great — closing pre-day items. If anything pops up overnight, reply here and we'll adjust. :thumbsup:
